Join Our Dynamic Team as a Web Development Project Manager : Help Empower Healthcare Professionals Worldwide!

Location:
Lebanon – Remote
Employment:
Full-time
Working Hours:
10:00 am – 6:00 pm Sydney time
Compensation: Up to US$2,500 per month
depending on experience and assessment.

Overview

We are looking for an experienced, highly organized and proactive Web Development Project Manager
to join our growing team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced digital environment, enjoys bringing structure to complex workflows and knows how to keep multiple projects, people and deadlines moving at the same time. You will be responsible for coordinating projects across different teams, monitoring progress, identifying potential delays and ensuring projects are completed accurately and on time. We are looking for someone who does more than simply update tasks. You should be comfortable taking ownership of projects from start to finish
, following up with team members, solving problems and escalating risks before they become issues.

Please note:
We are looking for candidates with web development project management experience
— this is a priority for the role. Experience in a digital marketing agency
is also highly preferred.

What You Will Do

Manage multiple projects simultaneously from planning through to completion.
Develop clear project timelines, milestones, priorities and deliverables.
Coordinate work across different teams, including design, development, marketing, content and other operational functions.
Assign and monitor tasks and ensure team members understand their responsibilities and deadlines.
Conduct regular project follow-ups and ensure outstanding tasks continue moving forward.
Identify bottlenecks, dependencies and potential delays early and take action to resolve them.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date project information within our project management systems.
Monitor deadlines and ensure projects are delivered according to agreed timelines.
Communicate project progress, risks, delays and required decisions clearly to management.
Run project meetings and ensure actions, owners and deadlines are clearly documented.
Follow up with team members on outstanding deliverables and hold stakeholders accountable for agreed deadlines.
Work closely with management to prioritize projects and allocate resources effectively.
Improve existing workflows, processes and project management systems.
Develop and maintain project documentation, SOPs and reporting where required.
Ensure completed work meets project requirements before projects are considered complete.

What We Require

Minimum 4 years of professional website development project management experience.

Demonstrated experience managing multiple projects and competing deadlines simultaneously.
Strong experience working with cross-functional teams.
Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate project records.
Excellent written and spoken English.
Strong communication skills and confidence following up with team members and stakeholders.
Ability to identify problems early and propose practical solutions rather than simply escalating issues.
Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
Technically fluent in dev workflows, including sprint planning, QA processes, and coordinating between design, development, and client teams.
Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
Experience using project management platforms such as Monday.com, Asana, ClickUp, Jira or similar
.
Strong working knowledge of Google Workspace, including Google Sheets, Docs and Drive.

Highly Regarded

Experience working in a digital marketing agency, technology company or similar fast-paced digital environment
.
Experience managing website, digital marketing, SEO, paid advertising, design or development projects.
Experience with Monday.com
.
Experience managing remote or internationally distributed teams.
Experience developing processes, workflows and SOPs.
Project management qualifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, Agile or Scrum certification
.

What Success Looks Like

You will be successful in this role if:
Projects are delivered on time and important deadlines are rarely missed.
Management has clear visibility over the status of every project.
Team members know exactly what they are responsible for and when it is due.
Delays and bottlenecks are identified before they become major problems.
Project information is accurate and consistently maintained.
You actively drive projects forward rather than waiting for others to provide updates.
Processes become more organized and efficient as a result of your involvement.

The Person We're Looking For

You don't need to be reminded to follow something up. If a deadline is approaching, you already know about it and are working with the relevant person to make sure it is delivered.
You are comfortable asking questions, challenging unrealistic timelines and holding people accountable while maintaining positive working relationships.
Most importantly, you have a strong ownership mentality
. When a project is assigned to you, you take responsibility for moving it forward and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

Meaningful perks that reflect our commitment:

Competitive salary, inclusive of a monthly retention bonus.
Remote position (work from anywhere)
, full-time, and long-term
Annual compensation review
Fitness subsidy for 12 months to support your well-being.
Birthday leave, so you can celebrate and enjoy your special day off!
We observe local public holidays, allowing team members to rest and celebrate their national holidays.
15 days of Paid time off, ensuring team members have time to relax and recharge.
Global exposure and friendly work environment
Opportunity to learn new techniques & tools with a young and dynamic team
Lead performance with autonomy and visibility across departments.
Remote-first, collaborative culture that values initiative and outcomes.

We celebrate diversity, welcome individuality, and create a space where every voice is heard and valued.

The AI Infrastructure GPU Delivery team is responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering the infrastructure that powers Oracle Cloud Infrastructure's rapidly expanding AI and GPU portfolio. The organization partners closely with Engineering, Cloud Platform, Networking, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Data Center Operations, Observability, Finance, Business Operations, hardware partners, and senior leadership to deliver highly complex infrastructure programs at global scale.

As a Principal Program Manager
, you will oversee the planning, execution, and operational readiness of strategic AI infrastructure and GPU delivery initiatives. You will be responsible for translating complex technical and operational requirements into integrated execution plans, establishing governance frameworks, driving cross-functional alignment, and ensuring successful delivery across multiple concurrent programs. Develop executive-level reporting and dashboards that communicate program health, operational KPIs, customer impact, dependencies, financial status, risks, mitigation plans, and key decisions.
Partner with Observability and Telemetry teams to improve visibility into GPU health, network fabric performance, RDMA, RoCE, InfiniBand, and overall service health.
Collaborate with internal engineering organizations and external hardware partners to improve deployment quality, operational efficiency, and time to resolution.
Establish scalable program management frameworks, documentation standards, runbooks, playbooks, onboarding materials, and repeatable delivery processes.
Drive continuous improvement through automation, AI-assisted workflows, data-driven decision making, validation frameworks, version readiness, and operational optimization.
Build and maintain consistent reporting, scorecards, KPIs, and program metrics to support executive decision-making and portfolio management.

jobs.description:
Description

As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon's unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers' businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon's real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.

AWS Skilling and Social Impact (SSI) offers AWS re/Start as a workforce development program that helps adults build skills including AI and cloud utilizes AWS certifications to validate those skills and connects graduates with career pathways. The program is free to the learner and delivered through a network of third-party collaborating organizations led by the AWS re/Start Regional Program Manager.

SSI is seeking a dynamic organized and experienced Program Manager who is passionate about skilling and workforce development programs for underserved communities. This individual will join the AWS re/Start team and be focused on building the program and expanding offerings in the Western part of the US and Canada.

The successful candidate will be able to take ownership of the program in the region by sustaining an effective network of delivery organizations. They will earn the trust of the relevant internal stakeholders to support the success of the program across the region.

The candidate will establish solid working relationships with other Amazon teams in order to access local and regional funding mechanisms for workforce development identify underserved communities who could benefit from AWS upskilling and reskilling offerings and monitor impact and seek ways to improve effectiveness across the region. The candidate must have a collaborative work style an entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to manage multiple workstreams.

Key job responsibilities

Own and grow the AWS re/Start program across the Western US and Canada sustaining an effective network of third-party delivery organizations that run the program at scale.
Build and manage relationships with collaborating delivery organizations-onboarding enabling and supporting them to deliver high-quality skilling outcomes for underserved communities.
Establish solid working relationships with internal AWS stakeholders and other Amazon teams to access local and regional funding mechanisms for workforce development.
Partner with AWS public sector and commercial account teams customers and Partners to identify opportunities to introduce adult skilling programs as a solution to customer needs.
Identify underserved communities that could benefit from AWS upskilling and reskilling offerings and connect graduates with career pathways.
Monitor program impact track outcomes and continuously seek ways to improve effectiveness across the region.
Manage multiple concurrent workstreams with an entrepreneurial collaborative approach earning trust across internal and external stakeholders.

A day in the life

Use local knowledge to deepen stakeholder network externally and deepen funding channels across public bodies charities and corporate organizations
Engage with AWS account teams in public sector and commercial organizations as well as externally with AWS customers and Partners to identify opportunities to introduce adult skilling programs as a solution to customer needs
Serve as the key AWS point of contact for collaborating organizations answering questions and directing collaborating organizations
Work with local AWS public relations teams to showcase program opportunities and success

About The Team

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of program or project management experience
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred Qualifications

2+ years of driving process improvements experience
Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
Knowledge of general AI tools
Experience designing, implementing, and scaling upskilling, apprenticeship, or workforce development programs across large-scale operations or corporate environments, including forecasting workforce needs and leveraging analytics to drive program decisions

jobs.description:
Job Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

Provides strategic and technical leadership for the design and implementation of agricultural access-to-finance interventions under CRS Afghanistan’s Resilient Rural Livelihoods portfolio. The role focuses on expanding commercially sustainable finance for farmers, producer organizations, agribusinesses, SMEs, processors, traders, and other actors operating within priority agricultural value chains. Working through a Market Systems Development (MSD) approach, the Project Manager strengthens the linkages between viable agricultural businesses, commercial transactions, and appropriate financing solutions by developing finance-ready investment pipelines, facilitating agribusiness preparation, and fostering partnerships with financial institutions, guarantee facilities, and investment funds.

The position leads efforts to identify agricultural investment opportunities, improve business and financial readiness, facilitate structured referrals to banks, MFIs, ACGF, IFC-supported initiatives, and other financing mechanisms, and support the development of innovative agricultural finance solutions. The role emphasizes private-sector engagement, value-chain finance, Sharia-compliant financing approaches, financial inclusion, and the mobilization of private capital to strengthen agricultural productivity, competitiveness, resilience, and market growth within Afghanistan's fragile and evolving context.

Roles And Key Responsibilities

Lead assessments of agricultural finance constraints, financing opportunities, and investment needs across priority value chains, agribusinesses, and producer organizations.
Develop and manage a qualified agricultural finance pipeline of agribusinesses, SMEs, producer organizations, processors, traders, and other market actors with potential to access repayable finance.
Design and oversee finance-readiness interventions, including business diagnostics, financial record strengthening, cash-flow analysis, investment planning, and business case development.
Establish and manage structured referral mechanisms linking finance-ready businesses with banks, MFIs, ACGF, IFC-supported initiatives, and other financing and investment facilities.
Collaborate with financial institutions and agricultural finance partners to align investment opportunities with appropriate financing pathways, financial products, and risk-mitigation mechanisms.
Facilitate the development and expansion of value-chain finance, embedded finance, supplier credit, buyer pre-financing, aggregation finance, and other commercially sustainable financing models.
Support agribusinesses, producer organizations, and farmers to improve financial literacy, finance readiness, and understanding of commercial financing requirements and obligations.
Lead collaboration with ACGF, participating financial institutions, and other partners to support agricultural finance pilots, product adaptation, and innovative financing models for priority value chains.
Coordinate periodic pipeline reviews, portfolio learning exercises, and performance assessments to improve referral quality, financing outcomes, and private capital mobilization.
Build and maintain strategic partnerships with financial institutions, guarantee facilities, agribusinesses, investors, donor-funded initiatives, government agencies, and private-sector stakeholders to strengthen agricultural finance ecosystems.
Provide technical leadership on agricultural finance, investment readiness, value-chain finance, financial inclusion, and private-sector engagement, ensuring that women, youth, returnees, and marginalized groups are effectively integrated into financing opportunities.

Key Deliverables

Agricultural finance and investment opportunity assessments completed for priority value chains, including analysis of financing constraints, capital requirements, and financing pathways
Agricultural finance pipeline management system established, including screening tools, referral procedures, tracking mechanisms, and pipeline reporting systems.
Finance-readiness assessments, business diagnostics, investment plans, and financing preparation packages completed for targeted agribusinesses and producer organizations.
Standardized referral packages prepared and submitted to ACGF, participating financial institutions, IFC-supported initiatives, and other financing facilities.
Financial literacy, cash-flow management, and finance-readiness training delivered to agribusinesses, producer organizations, and targeted farmers.
Agricultural finance, value-chain finance, and embedded finance models developed and operationalized with agribusiness, buyer, supplier, and financial-sector partners.
Collaborative financing pilots and agricultural finance product innovations designed and implemented with ACGF and participating financial institutions
Pipeline review reports, portfolio analyses, financing performance assessments, and learning products completed and disseminated.
Strategic partnership agreements and coordination mechanisms established with banks, MFIs, guarantee facilities, investors, and agricultural finance stakeholders.
Measurable increases achieved in agricultural finance transactions, qualified referrals, private capital mobilized, repeat lending, and financing access for targeted agricultural market actors

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Strong expertise in agricultural finance, value-chain finance, investment readiness, agribusiness development, and private-sector-led agricultural growth. Demonstrated ability to develop and manage agricultural finance pipelines and build partnerships with banks, MFIs, guarantee facilities, investors, agribusinesses, and other financial-sector stakeholders. Extensive knowledge of agricultural lending, Sharia-compliant finance, credit and risk assessment, embedded value-chain finance, guarantee mechanisms, financial inclusion, and agricultural investment promotion. Proven ability to prepare businesses for finance through business diagnostics, financial analysis, cash-flow modeling, investment planning, and financing structuring. Strong analytical and strategic planning skills, including experience assessing commercial viability, developing business cases, identifying financing constraints, and designing innovative financing solutions. Excellent stakeholder engagement, negotiation, communication, and relationship-management skills, with the ability to mobilize private capital, facilitate multi-stakeholder partnerships, and expand sustainable access to finance for farmers, producer organizations, agribusinesses, women, youth, and marginalized groups.

Knowledge

Strong knowledge of agricultural finance, value-chain finance, and rural financial systems.
Expertise in agribusiness investment readiness, financial analysis, and business case development.
Knowledge of Sharia-compliant financing instruments and agricultural lending products.
Understanding of guarantee mechanisms, risk-sharing facilities, and private capital mobilization.
Knowledge of agricultural value chains, market systems development, and commercial agriculture.

Skills

Agricultural finance and investment pipeline development skills.
Business diagnostics, cash-flow analysis, and financial modeling skills.
Financial institution engagement, partnership development, and negotiation skills.
Investment-readiness assessment and financing referral management skills.
Stakeholder facilitation, training, and capacity-strengthening skills.
Technical writing, reporting, and presentation skills.

Abilities

Ability to identify financeable agricultural opportunities and investment prospects.
Ability to translate market opportunities into viable financing transactions.
Ability to manage relationships with financial institutions and investment partners.
Ability to analyze financing constraints and develop appropriate solutions.
Ability to synthesize market, financial, and business information into actionable recommendations.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

Key Working Relationships

Program Director, Project Manager – Inclusive Agricultural Market Systems & Digitization, NRM & DRM Advisor, MEAL Officer, field teams.

External:
Banks, MFIs, ACGF, IFC-supported initiatives, private investors, agribusinesses, producer organizations, government agencies, donor-funded programs, and other financial-sector partners.

Bristol or London

About Us

Hoare Lea is a human-centric and planet-conscious engineering consultancy. We offer intelligent and sustainable solutions to complex design challenges for the built environment throughout the UK and further afield.

We provide a wide range of engineering and consultancy services, including acoustics, air quality, building services (MEP), fire, lighting, security and sustainability to name but a few. We are as committed to providing an environment where everyone can realise their unique potential. So, in joining Hoare Lea, you will experience a business that enriches your knowledge, supports your wellbeing, and welcomes your individuality. You’ll have the opportunity to participate in our 9-day fortnight scheme, thriving community groups, varied social and networking events, and extensive professional and technical development schemes. We also offer an extensive benefits package, including private medical cover, an electric vehicle salary sacrifice scheme, stock options, and 25 days of annual leave (increasing with service), alongside flexible and hybrid working.

Whatever your ambitions or circumstances, our aim is to enable everyone to develop their knowledge, give their best, and enjoy what they do.

About The Role

Our multi-disciplinary software, product, and data team serves as a central hub of digital expertise and innovation, supporting projects across the company. We work collaboratively with engineers, consultants and other specialists to use data and technology to solve real-world problems and improve the services we provide to our clients.

We have an opportunity for a Data Analyst/Scientist or Senior Data Analyst/Scientist to play a key role in using data, analytics, statistical methods and data science to generate insight, support decision-making and improve our engineering services.

This is a broad analytical role. You will work across the full lifecycle of a problem: understanding stakeholder needs, exploring and assessing data, identifying appropriate analytical approaches, communicating findings and, where appropriate, developing statistical or machine-learning models or client-ready insights/tools. This is a role for someone who enjoys variety and has a critical eye for finding the right solution for the problem. Sometimes this may be exploratory analysis, a dashboard or a set of clearly defined metrics; in other cases, it may involve forecasting, statistical modelling, machine learning or building/working with AI.

It's an exciting time to join our Digital team. Working alongside a range of specialist engineers and consultants, you will be joining a collaborative, knowledgeable, highly engaged team, and offer a supportive, flexible, and high-performing work culture. In a time where building and energy resilience is ever more important, we are driving forward innovation to make an impact with data and technology.

You will have the opportunity to engage in a variety of high-impact projects, working on challenging problems for some of the UK’s most notable organisations, including the NHS and Oxford University. Our team has recently worked on creating data science-led for managing estates in hospitals, building energy forecasting models, and harnessing data on building performance to create better designed buildings of the future.

In this key and varied role, you can expect to:

Work with engineers, consultants, product teams and other stakeholders to understand their needs and translate sometimes ambiguous questions into well-defined analytical problems.
Develop and implement data-driven solutions to solve real-world business problems across the company.
Use SQL, Python and other analytical tools to investigate datasets, identify trends and relationships, test hypotheses and generate actionable insights.
Apply appropriate statistical techniques, forecasting methods, ML and AI approaches where they add value to the problem being solved.
Collaborate with the product and software engineering teams to turn analytical work into reusable tools, workflows and data-driven products where appropriate.
Develop reproducible and maintainable analytical code, following best practices, including version control, testing, and peer reviews.
Contribute to the development of analytical and data science capability across the business by sharing approaches, reusable methods and good practice

About You

To be successful in this role you’ll need:

Essential Skills

Experience applying data and analysis to real-world business, engineering or operational problems.
Strong analytical problem-solving skills, with the ability to take an initially ambiguous question and determine an appropriate analytical approach.
Ability to work on projects independently and own deliverables.
Strong proficiency in Python for data manipulation, analysis, visualisation and data science (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn).
Proficiency in data querying languages (e.g., SQL). Solid understanding of software engineering best practices (version control, unit testing, code review, etc.).
Strong experience with data visualisation frameworks (e.g., PowerBI, Streamlit).
Experience applying machine learning and AI, including generative AI, to real-world problems where it provides clear benefit.
Familiarity with statistical concepts and their application in data analysis.
Solid communication skills, capable of effectively engaging with and presenting findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Understanding of data governance, privacy, responsible AI and other relevant standards.

Desirable Skills

Knowledge of the engineering industry and its challenges.
Experience with one of the major machine learning frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch).
Knowledge of mathematical optimisation methods, such as linear, integer or constraint optimisation, and associated tools (e.g. OR-Tools).
Experience with MS Fabric or equivalent data warehousing solution.
Experience working in a cloud computing environment.
Familiarity with containerisation and deployment technologies (e.g., Docker, CI/CD pipelines).

For candidates joining at Senior
level, we would additionally expect you to lead more complex or ambiguous analytical projects, shape analytical approaches and overarching priorities, work independently with senior stakeholders, review and support the work of others, and help raise analytical standards across the team.

How To Apply

To apply simply complete a CV profile and submit your application.

If shortlisted, one of our recruitment team will be in touch to arrange an introductory call (about 30 minutes) to discuss the role and your experience in more detail. From there, successful candidates will be invited to attend a panel interview, either via Microsoft Teams or in person at one of our offices. We aim to provide feedback at each stage of the process.

new_jobs.description:
Job Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

Provides strategic and technical leadership for the design and implementation of agricultural access-to-finance interventions under CRS Afghanistan’s Resilient Rural Livelihoods portfolio. The role focuses on expanding commercially sustainable finance for farmers, producer organizations, agribusinesses, SMEs, processors, traders, and other actors operating within priority agricultural value chains. Working through a Market Systems Development (MSD) approach, the Project Manager strengthens the linkages between viable agricultural businesses, commercial transactions, and appropriate financing solutions by developing finance-ready investment pipelines, facilitating agribusiness preparation, and fostering partnerships with financial institutions, guarantee facilities, and investment funds.

The position leads efforts to identify agricultural investment opportunities, improve business and financial readiness, facilitate structured referrals to banks, MFIs, ACGF, IFC-supported initiatives, and other financing mechanisms, and support the development of innovative agricultural finance solutions. The role emphasizes private-sector engagement, value-chain finance, Sharia-compliant financing approaches, financial inclusion, and the mobilization of private capital to strengthen agricultural productivity, competitiveness, resilience, and market growth within Afghanistan's fragile and evolving context.

Roles And Key Responsibilities

Lead assessments of agricultural finance constraints, financing opportunities, and investment needs across priority value chains, agribusinesses, and producer organizations.
Develop and manage a qualified agricultural finance pipeline of agribusinesses, SMEs, producer organizations, processors, traders, and other market actors with potential to access repayable finance.
Design and oversee finance-readiness interventions, including business diagnostics, financial record strengthening, cash-flow analysis, investment planning, and business case development.
Establish and manage structured referral mechanisms linking finance-ready businesses with banks, MFIs, ACGF, IFC-supported initiatives, and other financing and investment facilities.
Collaborate with financial institutions and agricultural finance partners to align investment opportunities with appropriate financing pathways, financial products, and risk-mitigation mechanisms.
Facilitate the development and expansion of value-chain finance, embedded finance, supplier credit, buyer pre-financing, aggregation finance, and other commercially sustainable financing models.
Support agribusinesses, producer organizations, and farmers to improve financial literacy, finance readiness, and understanding of commercial financing requirements and obligations.
Lead collaboration with ACGF, participating financial institutions, and other partners to support agricultural finance pilots, product adaptation, and innovative financing models for priority value chains.
Coordinate periodic pipeline reviews, portfolio learning exercises, and performance assessments to improve referral quality, financing outcomes, and private capital mobilization.
Build and maintain strategic partnerships with financial institutions, guarantee facilities, agribusinesses, investors, donor-funded initiatives, government agencies, and private-sector stakeholders to strengthen agricultural finance ecosystems.
Provide technical leadership on agricultural finance, investment readiness, value-chain finance, financial inclusion, and private-sector engagement, ensuring that women, youth, returnees, and marginalized groups are effectively integrated into financing opportunities.

Key Deliverables

Agricultural finance and investment opportunity assessments completed for priority value chains, including analysis of financing constraints, capital requirements, and financing pathways
Agricultural finance pipeline management system established, including screening tools, referral procedures, tracking mechanisms, and pipeline reporting systems.
Finance-readiness assessments, business diagnostics, investment plans, and financing preparation packages completed for targeted agribusinesses and producer organizations.
Standardized referral packages prepared and submitted to ACGF, participating financial institutions, IFC-supported initiatives, and other financing facilities.
Financial literacy, cash-flow management, and finance-readiness training delivered to agribusinesses, producer organizations, and targeted farmers.
Agricultural finance, value-chain finance, and embedded finance models developed and operationalized with agribusiness, buyer, supplier, and financial-sector partners.
Collaborative financing pilots and agricultural finance product innovations designed and implemented with ACGF and participating financial institutions
Pipeline review reports, portfolio analyses, financing performance assessments, and learning products completed and disseminated.
Strategic partnership agreements and coordination mechanisms established with banks, MFIs, guarantee facilities, investors, and agricultural finance stakeholders.
Measurable increases achieved in agricultural finance transactions, qualified referrals, private capital mobilized, repeat lending, and financing access for targeted agricultural market actors

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Strong expertise in agricultural finance, value-chain finance, investment readiness, agribusiness development, and private-sector-led agricultural growth. Demonstrated ability to develop and manage agricultural finance pipelines and build partnerships with banks, MFIs, guarantee facilities, investors, agribusinesses, and other financial-sector stakeholders. Extensive knowledge of agricultural lending, Sharia-compliant finance, credit and risk assessment, embedded value-chain finance, guarantee mechanisms, financial inclusion, and agricultural investment promotion. Proven ability to prepare businesses for finance through business diagnostics, financial analysis, cash-flow modeling, investment planning, and financing structuring. Strong analytical and strategic planning skills, including experience assessing commercial viability, developing business cases, identifying financing constraints, and designing innovative financing solutions. Excellent stakeholder engagement, negotiation, communication, and relationship-management skills, with the ability to mobilize private capital, facilitate multi-stakeholder partnerships, and expand sustainable access to finance for farmers, producer organizations, agribusinesses, women, youth, and marginalized groups.

Knowledge

Strong knowledge of agricultural finance, value-chain finance, and rural financial systems.
Expertise in agribusiness investment readiness, financial analysis, and business case development.
Knowledge of Sharia-compliant financing instruments and agricultural lending products.
Understanding of guarantee mechanisms, risk-sharing facilities, and private capital mobilization.
Knowledge of agricultural value chains, market systems development, and commercial agriculture.

Skills

Agricultural finance and investment pipeline development skills.
Business diagnostics, cash-flow analysis, and financial modeling skills.
Financial institution engagement, partnership development, and negotiation skills.
Investment-readiness assessment and financing referral management skills.
Stakeholder facilitation, training, and capacity-strengthening skills.
Technical writing, reporting, and presentation skills.

Abilities

Ability to translate market opportunities into viable financing transactions.
Ability to manage relationships with financial institutions and investment partners.
Ability to analyze financing constraints and develop appropriate solutions.
Ability to synthesize market, financial, and business information into actionable recommendations.

We also offer an extensive benefits package, including private medical cover, an electric vehicle salary sacrifice scheme, stock options, and 25 days of annual leave (increasing with service), alongside flexible and hybrid working.

Whatever your ambitions or circumstances, our aim is to enable everyone to develop their knowledge, give their best, and enjoy what they do.

About The Role

Our multi-disciplinary software, product, and data team serves as a central hub of digital expertise and innovation, supporting projects across the company. We work collaboratively with engineers, consultants and other specialists to use data and technology to solve real-world problems and improve the services we provide to our clients.

We have an opportunity for a Data Analyst/Scientist or Senior Data Analyst/Scientist to play a key role in using data, analytics, statistical methods and data science to generate insight, support decision-making and improve our engineering services.

This is a broad analytical role. You will work across the full lifecycle of a problem: understanding stakeholder needs, exploring and assessing data, identifying appropriate analytical approaches, communicating findings and, where appropriate, developing statistical or machine-learning models or client-ready insights/tools. This is a role for someone who enjoys variety and has a critical eye for finding the right solution for the problem. Sometimes this may be exploratory analysis, a dashboard or a set of clearly defined metrics; in other cases, it may involve forecasting, statistical modelling, machine learning or building/working with AI.

It's an exciting time to join our Digital team. Working alongside a range of specialist engineers and consultants, you will be joining a collaborative, knowledgeable, highly engaged team, and offer a supportive, flexible, and high-performing work culture. In a time where building and energy resilience is ever more important, we are driving forward innovation to make an impact with data and technology.

You will have the opportunity to engage in a variety of high-impact projects, working on challenging problems for some of the UK’s most notable organisations, including the NHS and Oxford University. Our team has recently worked on creating data science-led for managing estates in hospitals, building energy forecasting models, and harnessing data on building performance to create better designed buildings of the future.

In this key and varied role, you can expect to:

Work with engineers, consultants, product teams and other stakeholders to understand their needs and translate sometimes ambiguous questions into well-defined analytical problems.
Develop and implement data-driven solutions to solve real-world business problems across the company.
Use SQL, Python and other analytical tools to investigate datasets, identify trends and relationships, test hypotheses and generate actionable insights.
Apply appropriate statistical techniques, forecasting methods, ML and AI approaches where they add value to the problem being solved.
Collaborate with the product and software engineering teams to turn analytical work into reusable tools, workflows and data-driven products where appropriate.
Develop reproducible and maintainable analytical code, following best practices, including version control, testing, and peer reviews.
Contribute to the development of analytical and data science capability across the business by sharing approaches, reusable methods and good practice

About You

To be successful in this role you’ll need:

Essential Skills

Experience applying data and analysis to real-world business, engineering or operational problems.
Strong analytical problem-solving skills, with the ability to take an initially ambiguous question and determine an appropriate analytical approach.
Ability to work on projects independently and own deliverables.
Strong proficiency in Python for data manipulation, analysis, visualisation and data science (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn).
Proficiency in data querying languages (e.g., SQL). Solid understanding of software engineering best practices (version control, unit testing, code review, etc.).
Strong experience with data visualisation frameworks (e.g., PowerBI, Streamlit).
Experience applying machine learning and AI, including generative AI, to real-world problems where it provides clear benefit.
Familiarity with statistical concepts and their application in data analysis.
Solid communication skills, capable of effectively engaging with and presenting findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Understanding of data governance, privacy, responsible AI and other relevant standards.

Desirable Skills

Knowledge of the engineering industry and its challenges.
Experience with one of the major machine learning frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch).
Knowledge of mathematical optimisation methods, such as linear, integer or constraint optimisation, and associated tools (e.g. OR-Tools).
Experience with MS Fabric or equivalent data warehousing solution.
Experience working in a cloud computing environment.
Familiarity with containerisation and deployment technologies (e.g., Docker, CI/CD pipelines).

For candidates joining at Senior
level, we would additionally expect you to lead more complex or ambiguous analytical projects, shape analytical approaches and overarching priorities, work independently with senior stakeholders, review and support the work of others, and help raise analytical standards across the team.

To apply simply complete a CV profile and submit your application.
